Overview & City Profile

Scuol (Scuol (BFS 3762)) is a municipality in Region Engiadina Bassa / Val Muestair, Canton of Graubünden (coordinates 46.7346°N, 10.3263°E; population 4,624). Visitors use Scuol as a base to explore Canton of Graubünden's historic town centers, regional markets, and culinary specialties such as Capuns, Pizzoccheri, Bündner Nusstorte (walnut tart).

Within Canton of Graubünden Region (Region Engiadina Bassa / Val Muestair region), Scuol (Scuol (BFS 3762)) serves as a municipality (gemeinde / commune) in canton of graubünden region. Travelers exploring Canton of Graubünden often combine a stop in Scuol with regional highlights such as St. Moritz & Engadin Valley, Bernina Express & Landwasser Viaduct, Davos Klosters & Arosa, Swiss National Park (Zernez).

Getting to Scuol & Getting Around

Via the regional hub (Chur Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)): Rhaetian Railway (RhB) UNESCO network from Chur to St. Moritz, Davos, Arosa and Tirano (Bernina Express).

  • Local rail & IC cards: Once in Canton of Graubünden Region, JR regional lines and local private railways connect Chur with Scuol. Nationwide IC cards (Transit Card, Pasmo, Icoca) work on major urban and JR commuter gates; for rural branch lines or local buses, keep CHF 1,000 bills and CHF 100 coins handy for the onboard fare box.
  • Luggage & station lockers: Main stations in Canton of Graubünden have coin lockers for day-trippers. If you are stopping in Scuol en route between larger bases, check your suitcase dimensions in our Luggage & Locker Checker or forward big bags ahead with Takkyubin.
  • Driving & car rental: While city centers around Scuol are accessible by train and taxi, renting a car from a major SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways station or airport in Canton of Graubünden can be rewarding for reaching mountain gorges, coastal viewpoints, and countryside onsen. Read our Renting a Car in Switzerland Guide.

Practical Travel Tips for Scuol

  • Tourist information center (観光案内所): Look for the Kankō Annaijo counter inside or right outside the main train station in Scuol (or at Chur Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways)) for free walking maps, bus timetables, and festival calendars.
  • Cash & ATMs: While hotels, chain stores, and convenience stores in Scuol accept international cards and IC payment, smaller family-run restaurants, shrines, and rural buses often prefer cash. 7-Eleven (Seven Bank) and Switzerland Post ATMs accept foreign debit cards reliably.
  • Dining hours: Outside major metropolitan hubs, lunch typically runs 11:30 AM–2:00 PM and dinner spots open around 5:30 PM, with earlier last orders (around 8:00–9:00 PM) in smaller cities.

Frequently asked questions

Where is Scuol (Scuol (BFS 3762)) located in Switzerland?

Scuol (Scuol (BFS 3762)) is a municipality (gemeinde / commune) located in Canton of Graubünden Region in the Region Engiadina Bassa / Val Muestair region of Switzerland (coordinates: 46.7346°N, 10.3263°E). It has a population of approximately 4,624 across an area of Regional km².

How do I get to Scuol by train?

Most visitors reach Scuol via the main prefectural gateway of Chur Central Station (SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways). Rhaetian Railway (RhB) UNESCO network from Chur to St. Moritz, Davos, Arosa and Tirano (Bernina Express). From the regional hub, connect by JR local/rapid lines, private commuter railways, or local bus to Scuol. You can estimate long-distance rail costs using our SBB CFF FFS & Panoramic Alpine Railways Fare Calculator.

What local food is Scuol and Canton of Graubünden known for?

In Scuol and across Canton of Graubünden Region, top local dishes include Capuns, Pizzoccheri, Bündner Nusstorte (walnut tart), as well as Bündnerfleisch air-dried beef and Malans Pinot Noir. Look for local ekiben (station bento boxes), morning markets, and family-run shokudo near the main station.

When is the best time of year to visit Scuol?

Best time to visit Canton of Graubünden: Jun–Oct, Dec–Mar. Check our Switzerland Seasonal Calendar to compare month-by-month weather and crowd levels.
